subject: A Level Physics
title: Potential divider with a thermistor
question:
Fig. 2.1 shows a battery of e.m.f. 12 V and negligible internal resistance connected to a fixed resistor R of resistance 2.0 kΩ and a thermistor T. A voltmeter of very high resistance is connected across R.
(a) At 20 °C the resistance of T is 4.0 kΩ. Calculate the reading on the voltmeter.
(b) The temperature of T increases. State and explain how the reading on the voltmeter changes.
